# netbox_service (Data Source)

Retrieves a single service from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_service" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "service_id" {
  value = data.netbox_service.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the service.
- `created` (String) When the service was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the service, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the service.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipaddresses` (List of Number) The IDs of the ipaddresses of the service.
- `last_updated` (String) When the service was last changed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the service.
- `parent` (String) The parent of the service.
- `parent_object_id` (Number) The parent object id of the service.
- `parent_object_type` (String) The parent object type of the service.
- `port_mappings` (List of String) The port mappings of the service.
- `ports` (List of Number) The ports of the service.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol of the service.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
